dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}! Festival Utsava has not started. So food, not ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About brothers...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala ran away with sobs, after Arapacati got angry.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: They have been making food and repenting, carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Thanks to Nara {NICKNAME}, or they will keep seeing cooking training as the most important, and forget Arapacati's words about no fights.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Nara Varuna...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Nara Varuna cooks many many dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Brothers afraid of fire, however. They didn't see the cooking clearly, and started cooking training after Nara Varuna left.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is Golden Nara, too. Nara {NICKNAME} must know how to cook many many dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas, and Araphala will take a closer look this time, and learn about Nara cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck with the preparation.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Yes! For Festival Utsava, Arapacati will.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} enjoys a special taste, so brothers and sister want "special cooking training."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Special cooking training?

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Yes, Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas and Araphala remember "the taste of happiness" of Nara. Very special, more special than any smell in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #So they want "special cooking training." We'll share "the taste of happiness," when Nara {NICKNAME} comes back.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Hope they don't be so silly this time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Brothers and sister...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Nara Varuna looked so happy, so joyful, when talking about {M#brothers}{F#sisters}. Nara are weird. Why are "brothers" and "sisters" so special?

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: We later decided, we should be "brothers" and "sisters," to make everyone happy and joyful.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: At first, Arapacati was "brother." But the "sister" back then is gone now. Before being Vasara Tree, he decided that Arapacati should be "sister."

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Who should be "sister" next time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck with the training.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Yes! We will make the taste that gives Nara {NICKNAME} happiness.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's hope this goes smoothly...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Yes, it will be fine. Aranara are all afraid of fire, except for us brothers and sisters. That's why Arapacati made this pot. With this pot, the fire will be very, very small — not too hot and not too scary.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Arapacati made one for Nara {NICKNAME} as a show of thanks. I hope that the scent of happiness will always be with Nara {NICKNAME}.
